text:
aline: FYI — support ticket #4321, org 'magellan' sees $0 costs for yesterday on token-cost dashboard.

samir: looking... any repro steps from support?

aline: they attached CSV export and UI screenshot. CSV shows tokens but cost column is 0 or NaN for some rows. Only affects orgs with EUR billing.

eng-analytics: I ran a quick query:

```
SELECT org_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(tokens * price_usd) as usd_cost
FROM ledger_usage l
LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON l.model_id = p.model_id AND l.usage_hour >= p.effective_at
WHERE l.org_id = 'magellan' AND date(l.usage_hour) = '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY org_id;
```

eng-analytics: result had tokens > 0 but usd_cost = 0. price_usd is NULL for some model_ids.

tess: do those orgs have currency conversion applied? they bill in EUR in our Billing table.

eng-analytics: Yes. looks like the fx_rate join returns NULL when price_usd present but fx table missing EUR rate for that day. Our cost calc pipeline multiplies price_usd * fx_rate and treats NULL as 0 downstream.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: rolling back PR #998-fx-ingest-fix reverted yesterday

samir: that explains timing. fx ingestion failed for 03-15 around 04:00 UTC.

aline: support asked for repro steps and ETA to fix for impacted orgs.

samir: short-term fix: update billing job to treat NULL fx_rate as 1 and mark as needs-review so we don't zero costs. I'll run patch and backfill.

eng-analytics: proposed SQL backfill:

```
UPDATE billing_costs c
SET cost = COALESCE(cost, tokens * COALESCE(price_usd, 0) * COALESCE(fx_rate,1))
FROM (
  SELECT l.id as usage_id, l.tokens, p.price_usd, f.fx_rate
  FROM ledger_usage l
  LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON l.model_id = p.model_id
  LEFT JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = 'EUR' AND date(f.date) = date(l.usage_hour)
  WHERE date(l.usage_hour) = '2026-03-15' AND l.org_id IN ('magellan','vesta')
) sub
WHERE c.usage_id = sub.usage_id;
```

tess: please include a note to customers to say it's a display calc bug, not free credits.

samir: ack. I'll patch pipeline, kick off backfill for affected orgs, and post status here when done.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-47 for fx ingestion, severity P2.

aline: thanks — I'll update ticket and let customers know ETA ~1-2 hours for backfill.

samir: backfill started 2173456790. will ping when complete.

samir: backfill finished. re-run dashboard, values look restored for magellan and vesta.

tess: closing loop with customers. Good catch.
